title: Quick Savory Egyptian Shrimp Skewers
description: A pungent and indulgent Egyptian dish featuring saeujeot shrimp paste and tempering chocolate, perfect for a low-carb friendly meal. This recipe combines the bold flavors of Egypt with the richness of chocolate.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
In a bowl, mix together the saeujeot shrimp paste, tempering chocolate, lemon juice, garlic, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto the shrimp, making sure they are fully coated.
Grill the shrimp for 8-10 minutes, or until they are pink and fully cooked.
Serve the shrimp hot, garnished with lemon wedges and parsley.
Let the shrimp rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
Serve with a side of mixed greens or a low-carb friendly vegetable.
Garnish with additional parsley and lemon wedges if desired.
